name: Kholes
description: Kholes was a planet in Imperial space and the home of a Rebel outpost. In 1 ABY, soon after an outbreak of Bledsoe's disease on the nearby planet Tay'ah'loo, the Rebel outpost was wiped out by Imperial forces.
